scope: Conditional information and prediction on 651 neuron simulation settings and five robot failure tasks. The exact support result for copied targets is tested on two four-observation tables and 117 measured force and torque episodes. The programs and reports retain their separate data, target and numerical scopes. The later office recording separates the signed prediction gain from movement in the four categorical contributions after replacing carbon dioxide by a constant.
